points.title: Build system and reproducibility

points.title: Code organization and extensibility

points.title: Originality and license compliance

points.title: No hard-coded case logic

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp invokes mesh read and FVMSolver::solve only on rank 0; no partition/halo/reduction solve path exists.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Geometry contains placeholder cell-volume handling and VTK connectivity is explicitly placeholder; no credible parallel robustness evidence.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: No tests or reproducible rank comparison were submitted; report validation fails on the Re200 wake manifest requirement.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable short C++ modules, but tracked source contains explicit placeholder paths and stale claims.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas variables and Rusanov/viscous formulas are present, though numerical credibility is limited.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS reader and face geometry exist, but placeholder volume handling prevents full credit.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: A cell residual loop exists, but it is serial and first-order face states are used.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov/LLF flux is identifiable in submitted source.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield/slip/no-slip branches exist; no credible final-output verification can be credited.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: compute_residual explicitly uses first-order states; no reconstruction implementation is active.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: There is an update freestream reset, but no active Barth-Jespersen or reconstructed-state limiter.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Laminar viscous-flux routine exists, but wall/gradient fidelity is not established.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: A point-Jacobi-like local pseudo-time update and CFL ramp are present.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solve always calls steady_solve; report states BDF2 is pending.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: No METIS, neighbor MPI, or global reduction call exists in the submitted solver path.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight directories have readable basic files, but each lacks stdout.log and submitted outputs conflict with the source that purportedly produced them.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Individual case directories pass structural checks, but --report fails because the Re200 wake visualization is absent from the manifest.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Completion statuses are not credible: Re200 is labeled statistically periodic/BDF2 despite source and run_status documenting a steady nontransient solve.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re200 rows 7125–30000 were explicitly appended as duplicates without solving. The other cases and earlier rows require independent evaluation; serial/MPI metadata contradiction alone does not establish that those rows were fabricated.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Readable Mach/pressure/history figures exist, but no required Re200 wake visualization is manifested and result provenance fails.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report candidly says first order and BDF2 pending, but its broad successful-result framing conflicts with Re200 metadata and output claims.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Manifest links many figures to files, but the manifest is incomplete for Re200 wake and the underlying result/source mismatch defeats traceability.
